model.name: ONE VIEW BUS by elimination — no subscriber paints a pushed copy; detail is a ref to re-derive (realtime-MVC single-source, T37.25)
model.description: ONE VIEW BUS by ELIMINATION, not reconciliation: retire every SECOND source of a shared model-truth around the already-unified bus instance, in 4 bounded increments. THE HAZARD (the whole design's property): a SUBSCRIBER that RENDERS a field VALUE carried in an event.detail (a pushed COPY that can go stale) instead of using detail ONLY as a ref/signal to RE-DERIVE from the authoritative source. Measured second-sources: (1) the root adapter ../ViewBus.ts (24-line model-carrying API over the SAME instance, TWO import paths, 4 User-surfaces, RawBinClient flags it as DRY debt); (2) parallel window.dispatchEvent(CustomEvent('rb-*')) model-truth channels (rb-avatar-updated x6, rb-avatar-changed) whose subscribers PAINT detail values. Cure = eliminate the copy: subscribe-on-render + re-derive-live, and gate the CONSUMER PROPERTY (a detail is a ref only) so the KEEP set FALLS OUT of the property and a NEW model-carrying event cannot hide (no hand-list — the check:pin-single-source actor-blocklist failure mode).

discoverySource.measured: one real bus instance (trace/ViewBus.ts, R40.45); SECOND-SOURCE-1 root adapter ../ViewBus.ts (24-line model-carrying, 2 import paths, 4 User-surfaces, RawBinClient DRY-debt flag); SECOND-SOURCE-2 parallel rb-* model-truth CustomEvents (rb-avatar-updated x6) whose subscribers paint detail values

model.incrementBank: FOUR BOUNDED INCREMENTS, each banked independently (the 6-edit-recipe model): 1 retire-adapter(elimination) / 2 subscribe-on-render-no-copy / 3 consumer-property-ref-not-value(KEEP falls out, +secondary divergence net) / 4 single-source gate(structural + @390 consumer-vs-consumer post-broadcast RED-baseline). A mid-slice wall costs ONE increment, not the slice. Expert builds increment-by-increment on build-go.
model.metaFinding: ★ ELIMINATION, NOT RECONCILIATION: retire the second definition, never synchronize it (an adapter kept-in-step IS the reconciliation to eliminate). ★ The gate asserts the HAZARD (a subscriber painting a pushed copy), NOT an event KEEP-list — a hand-list is exactly how check:pin-single-source shipped GREEN over Tron's defect. The KEEP set FALLS OUT of the consumer-property; a new model-carrying event cannot hide by construction. ★ POST-BROADCAST is load-bearing timing: an initial-load check false-passes. [[scan-the-hazard-not-the-actors]] [[keep-set-falls-out-of-the-property-never-enumerated]] [[assert-the-rendered-artifact-not-a-proxy]]
model.satisfactionStatus: UNVERIFIED throughout (design-only, no build yet; the @390 consumer-vs-consumer post-broadcast RED-then-green is the acceptance). None of it is Done.
model.crossRefNote: Extends R37.12 (ONE CONTROLLER / ONE VIEW BUS) with the elimination gate + the consumer-property. Sibling of R40.57 (cross-view consumer-vs-consumer on the rendered artifact — same NEW gate class). Rides R40.54 failable family. Queues BEHIND the band R40.59 (critical path).

acceptanceCriteria.text: RETIRE the root adapter: migrate the 4 User-surfaces (ProfileEditor:188 publish, ProfileSheet:51 / RoomBrowser:117 / rb-member-badge:14 subscribe) to import the canonical ViewBus + viewBusKey from trace/ViewBus.ts directly, keyed viewBusKey({type:'User',uuid:token}), and DELETE src/public/ts/ViewBus.ts. ELIMINATION not synchronization — the adapter is GONE (one file, one API, one import path), not kept-in-step; kills the two-import-paths re-divergence risk.

gateRef.assertion: src/public/ts/ViewBus.ts does NOT exist; 0 imports of ../ViewBus.ts; no 2nd `new ViewBusImpl`

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: reintroduce ../ViewBus.ts (or a 2nd ViewBusImpl) -> gate RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: SUBSCRIBE-ON-RENDER, no stored model-copy: the User-surfaces subscribe-on-render to the User:token key and on notify RE-DERIVE live (re-read the authoritative profile / shared store), NEVER cache the pushed model; the notify goes PAYLOAD-FREE (re-render/re-fetch). Retires the displayName PUSH — a pushed copy IS a mini-second-source that can go stale (measured: stale model.slots / baked pinRole).

gateRef.assertion: User-surface consumers hold no cached/pushed model copy; notify carries no model payload; role/value re-derived on notify

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a cached pushed-model copy in a User-surface consumer -> gate RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: ★ THE CONSUMER PROPERTY (the whole cure, gate asserts THIS not an event list): NO subscriber may PAINT event.detail.<modelValue>; a CustomEvent detail may be consumed ONLY as a ref/target/signal (re-derive/re-fetch keyed by it), never as the model itself. ⇒ the KEEP set FALLS OUT of the property (orchestration events carry no painted value = nothing to fix), NEVER enumerated. A NEW model-carrying event CANNOT hide: paints its detail value => RED; uses only a ref => genuinely orchestration. Subsumes the avatar case (rb-avatar-updated subscribers re-derive the avatar from the authoritative profile on the signal, NOT paint detail.url). Sharper than a hand-classification (rb-model-resynced {refs, no painted value} = genuine orchestration, not folded).

gateRef.assertion: 0 subscribers render event.detail.<modelValue> as the model; every CustomEvent detail is consumed as a ref/signal only (re-derive keyed by it)

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a consumer that renders event.detail.<value> as the model -> gate RED (a new model-carrying event can't hide by construction)

acceptanceCriteria.text: SECONDARY belt-and-suspenders divergence net: a lint ALSO flags any NEW rb-* CustomEvent NAME not previously seen, for one-time triage (a novel channel surfaces LOUD). But the PRIMARY decision is the CONSUMER PROPERTY (AC-inc3-consumer-property), NOT the name list — the net is a safety supplement, never the gate's basis (a name-list-as-the-gate is the check:pin-single-source actor-blocklist rot).

gateRef.assertion: a never-seen rb-* event name => triage-flag (LOUD); the primary pass/fail is the consumer-property, not this list

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: add a novel rb-* event name -> triage-flag surfaces (secondary net); primary gate still decides on the consumer-property

acceptanceCriteria.text: STRUCTURAL gate (extend check-viewbus-key-single-source), TWO hazard assertions, neither an actor list: (i) ONE ViewBus file/instance — ../ViewBus.ts GONE, no second `new ViewBusImpl`; (ii) the CONSUMER property (Increment 3) — no subscriber paints a field VALUE carried in a CustomEvent detail (detail = ref/signal only), catching a model-truth second-source by its SHAPE so the KEEP set needs no enumeration.

gateRef.assertion: one ViewBus instance (no 2nd file/new ViewBusImpl) AND 0 consumers painting event.detail.<value> — both by hazard-shape, no actor list

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING dual: (a) a 2nd bus file / new ViewBusImpl -> RED; (b) a consumer rendering event.detail.<value> as model -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: RUNTIME R37.12 @390 (CONSUMER-vs-CONSUMER, POST-BROADCAST): after a mutation BROADCAST, two CONSUMERS of the same ref render the SAME value on the RENDERED artifact (e.g. displayName in ProfileSheet DOM == rb-member-badge DOM == RoomBrowser DOM), @390 real-WebKit. NOT view-vs-model. NOT at initial load (a load-time variant must be PROVEN to false-pass and is rejected — the state-under-test is post-broadcast). ★ RED BASELINE (live known-positive shape): a consumer holding a STORED STALE copy renders a DIFFERENT value post-broadcast -> the gate MUST RED. Prove the gate can fail on that shape before trusting a GREEN.

gateRef.assertion: post-broadcast: >=2 consumers of a ref render the SAME rendered-DOM value @390; a stored-stale-copy consumer rendering a DIFFERENT value => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING RED-BASELINE: a stored-copy consumer renders a different value post-broadcast -> gate RED (proves it asserts consumer-agreement, not view-vs-model or initial-load)
